definitions.gloss: aerial bombing; air strike; bombing from the air
definitions.explanation: An attack in which bombs are dropped from aircraft onto targets on the ground. A concise, modern term commonly used in news reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軍事|ぐんじ}→軍事：14392_gunji⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{空爆|くうばく}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Military facilities were bombed from the air.

examples.japanese: {空爆|くうばく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{民間人|みんかんじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Civilians are also being harmed by the air strikes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空爆|くうばく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{即時|そくじ}→即時：22475_sokuji⟧⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{声明|せいめい}→声明：03763_seimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The United Nations issued a statement demanding an immediate halt to the air strikes.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{空|くう}→空〜：03949_kuu⟧ (sky, air) and {爆|ばく} (bomb, explosion). A modern, concise term favored in news headlines and contemporary reporting. Also functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {空爆|くうばく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to bomb from the air).

USAGE:
The standard term in contemporary news for describing military air strikes. More concise and modern-sounding than ⟦{爆撃|ばくげき}→爆撃：13584_bakugeki⟧ or ⟦{空襲|くうしゅう}→空襲：19775_kuushuu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空爆|くうばく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to carry out an air strike
- {空爆|くうばく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ — to be hit by an air strike
- {空爆|くうばく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}する→中止する：21909_chuushisuru⟧ — to halt air strikes
- ⟦{無差別|むさべつ}→無差別：13492_musabetsu⟧{空爆|くうばく} — indiscriminate bombing

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{空襲|くうしゅう}→空襲：19775_kuushuu⟧ — air raid; more historical, strongly associated with WWII
- ⟦{爆撃|ばくげき}→爆撃：13584_bakugeki⟧ — bombing; the general military term for dropping bombs
- ⟦{砲撃|ほうげき}→砲撃：19779_hougeki⟧ — shelling; artillery fire from the ground
